"There is a specific pool of bosses that can appear on each level ... However, no boss will appear more than once in a single play through." / "The lists below show the known bosses that can appear on each level." (section 7, per chapter, Level One..Twelve)
"Some of this data may be incomplete" - per-boss chapter + level ranges, e.g. Sky Captain Smiggs (all chapters, levels 6-7), Dagg Cruelmight (all chapters, levels 3-5), Kazamon Steelskin (levels 6-8)
"Only a handful of them is specific to one chapter (as Gallywix or Queen Wagtoggle, for Dalaran Bank)" (no level data)
"While some bosses are chapter-specific ... majority of them can appear any time." (no per-level lists; same boss roster for Heroic with different Hero Powers)

notes: Pools = wiki template (most complete source) + 4 additions from our live recordings (Smiggs ch1 L6/L7, Dagg ch5 L3, Aki ch5 L8) - 2 removals (Marei Loom and The Great Akazamzarak at ch5 L1, kept under "unconfirmed").

Heroic uses the same pools: no source gives separate Heroic pools, every Heroic recording fits the Normal pools, and Heroic reuses the same DALA_BOSS_xxh hero cards (Heroic differs by Hero Power / deck, see each boss page).

Level, not encounter: level = non-tavern bosses already fought + 1. Bartender Bob (DALA_BOSS_99h 52913; rarely Bartendotron DALA_BOSS_98h 56479) comes after levels 3 and 5. The Normal ch1 run (20261001-162435) has Bob twice in BOSSES_FOUGHT_LIST, so the positions file put Kaye Toogie at "encounter 6"; her NEXT_BOSS_HEALTH 30 = level 4, which the wiki agrees with.
Recorded NEXT_BOSS_HEALTH ladder (same in Normal and Heroic): L1 10, L2 15, L3 20, L4 30, L5 40, L6 50, L7 60, L8 70, L9 75, L10 80, L11 90, L12 100 (it is the value the level was matched against).

Save-data mechanic: while no run is active, NEXT_BOSS_FIGHT holds 5 dbf ids = one pre-rolled level-1 boss per chapter (index = chapter - 1; matched the first boss in 22/22 recorded run starts). During a run all 5 entries = the next boss.
No boss repeats within a run (Icy Veins quote; 0 repeats in 24 recorded runs). Pools overlap between levels, so the picker must skip bosses already fought this run.
Chapter 5 levels 9-12 are fixed: Magistrix Norroa, Archmage Vargoth, Archmage Kalec, Archmage Khadgar (wiki: "The last four bosses are always the same for every run"; recorded in Heroic).

"unconfirmed" entries: claimed by a source but contradicted by recordings or only from Icy Veins (early, incomplete "known bosses" list that also wrongly puts Marei Loom at L1 of chapters 2-4). The server should not pick them unless a recording confirms one.
No client data holds the pools (Scenario.json only has Player2HeroCardId = the chapter cover boss); pools are server-side.

Reddit (r/hearthstone) could not be fetched (old.reddit JSON blocked, search engines returned no boss-pool post); HSTopDecks chapter guides and Neoseeker FAQ are 403 to curl and the fetched HSTopDecks pages have no per-level lists.
